bagPolicy.summary: The venue permits clear plastic or vinyl totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches. All other bags must be returned to the vehicle.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking in Fields 4 and 5 has no additional charge; preferred parking is in Field 5 and VIP/Premier/Reserve/Easy Out parking is in Lot 5A.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit and concert-arrival guides do not identify a designated rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverage points of sale accept credit and debit only; a cash-to-card kiosk is near Tunnel D in the Main Plaza. One factory-sealed or empty water bottle up to 1 liter is allowed.
allowed: One factory-sealed or empty water bottle up to 1 liter
